messages:
eli: quick ping — PR #2083 updates caching TTL and quantizer profile for ggml-4bit. Can someone take a quick look? Link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2083 :eyes:

jia: @eli can you paste the perf numbers and the bench config so we can eyeball the regressions?

eli: perf snapshot from local a2-highmem run (seq=512):
- baseline p95 = 120ms -> new = 102ms
- throughput baseline = 420 tok/s -> new = 386 tok/s
- error rate unchanged (0.01%)
bench cmd: `./tools/bench --model vicuna-13b --seq 512 --workers 4`

noah: those look promising for tail, but what's the behavior under KV-cache heavy workloads? Also need to confirm autoscaler doesn't overreact to the throughput dip.

infra-bot: deploy-canary triggered for pr/2083 in us-west1 (2 pods). Canary job id: canary-2083-2026-04-03. Health checks: passing.

deepa: skimmed the diff — LGTM overall. One nit: there's a TODO left in `quant/profile` that affects fallback ordering, can you either remove or document it?

eli: ack, will remove the TODO in the next commit. Quick Q: PR tags the model variant with `quantized=v1`. If the quantized variant is out of capacity, do we auto-fallback to the float variant? Currently routing might prefer same-arch fallback, want to be explicit.

jia: prefer explicit fallback in the route. Add `fallback: revert-to: vicuna-13b-fp16` to the deployment manifest so operators know the intent.

noah: I can give formal approval after a short canary run at 100 rps for 10m and a tiny docs update about fallback. @eli can you kick that canary and post the logs here?

eli: started the canary at 17:18 UTC. Will post a short summary when it's done.

sre-watch: note: autoscaler floor locked to 2 pods during maintenance window (23:00-03:00) FYI for merge timing.

eli: canary finished — 10m at 100 rps: p95 steady ~104ms, error rate 0.02%, no fallback events observed. Pushed commit removing TODO and adding fallback manifest.

deepa: approving now :thumbsup:

noah: approving as well. Please merge in the next maintenance window (avoid peak hours).

eli: thanks all — merging after CI green. Will monitor for 2 hours post-merge and drop a short incident note if anything odd crops up. :rocket:
